description: Family offices actively writing startup checks, each checked against public sources. Seeded from The Founders Corner's Q3 2026 report and CNBC's monthly family office deal roundups (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026). Deals live in deals.json and reference offices by id.

field_guide.type: single_family_office = one family's own money; multi_family_office = manages money for several families; family_holding_company = investment arm of a family-controlled business group; investment_entity = a principal's personal investing vehicle; unverified = name not confirmed in public sources
field_guide.verification: verified = identity and principal confirmed by two or more independent public sources; partial = identity confirmed but some fields thinly sourced; unverified = could not confirm the entity exists under this name
field_guide.q3_2026_deal_count: Publicly reported Q3 2026 deals as counted by the seed article. A floor. Null means the article gave no count.
field_guide.null values: A null field means no reliable public source was found. It does not mean the answer is no.
field_guide.contact: Business contact details the firm, a regulator, or an official press release published. No home addresses, personal emails, or personal phones, and no emails guessed from name patterns. Some addresses are registered or filing addresses rather than staffed offices; the contact note says so.
field_guide.key_people: People publicly named in a business role at the office, each with a source. Titles follow the source and may lag recent changes.

offices.founder_note: Energy-focused family office. Reported to have committed about $500M to energy credit firm EOC Partners. Founding year conflicts across sources (2008 vs 2009).

contact.notes: No official website found; centauruscapital.com is a parked domain redirecting to a lander page. Address confirmed in two SEC prospectus selling-holder tables (Sharecare 424B3, July 2022: c/o Centaurus Capital LP, 1717 West Loop South, Suite 1800, Houston, TX 77027; Earthstone Energy 424B7, May 2023, same address). Do not confuse with the unrelated London hedge fund also named Centaurus Capital LP (SEC CIK 0001297966, 33 Cavendish Square, London), whose 13F filings appear in EDGAR searches. Laura Arnold is co-founder of Arnold Ventures with John Arnold, but no official source found identifies her in a business role at Centaurus Capital LP, so she is not listed. No phone or email published.

addresses.label: Headquarters (SEC EDGAR business address; 13F-HR filed Aug 2026)

contact.notes: Website says the firm is based in Chicago with offices in Chicago and San Francisco; no street address on the site. The Chicago street address comes from SEC EDGAR (Builders Vision, LLC, CIK 1785504) and its 13F-HR. Earlier SEC filings (2022-2024) listed a Bentonville, AR business address. The phone 479-464-1500 is the EDGAR registrant phone and the 13F signatory (General Counsel) contact number; it is an Arkansas area code, so it may route to the Bentonville office rather than Chicago. The email website@buildersvision.com is the 'How to contact us' address in the site privacy policy (legal@buildersvision.com is given for California privacy requests); the general inquiry route is the 'Build the Future With Us' form on the homepage (options: Investment, Philanthropy, Communications, Job Opportunities).

Address and phone are from the SEC EDGAR registrant record for Gates Frontier, LLC, and match its 13G/13D filings (Kirkland, WA); 5210 Carillon Point is the Carillon Point complex also used by Cascade Investment. offices.founder_note: Deal notices say only 'the Peugeot family office'. Contact details are for Peugeot Invest, the family's listed investment company and most likely entity, majority-owned by the family holding Établissements Peugeot Frères.

contact.notes: Mapped to Peugeot Invest SA (SIREN 562075390), the Euronext-listed long-term investment company majority-owned by Établissements Peugeot Frères (the Peugeot family holding), which holds the family's Stellantis and Forvia stakes via Peugeot 1810 and makes minority, private equity and co-investments. Établissements Peugeot Frères is the family holding company itself, but Peugeot Invest is the family's investing arm and the one with published contact details. Address and phone come from Peugeot Invest's own AMF-filed press release (April 2024); the email is on the official website and legal-notice page. The site also says it has a London office, but no London address was found. Yahoo Finance describes the HQ as Paris, which conflicts with the official Neuilly-sur-Seine registered office. The 2024 press release also gives a named press contact email for Sébastien Coquard; it is not listed as the general email. The governance page lists Edouard Peugeot as Chairman; older sources name Robert Peugeot, so the current chair is as shown on the site at time of research. French registry sites (Pappers, annuaire-entreprises) could not be fetched to cross-check.

offices.name: Volta Circle
offices.founder_note: Its own website says it is backed by the Lohia family, founders and majority shareholders of Indorama Ventures. Backed Syntetica at seed and Series A.

contact.notes: Ownership confirmed by the firm's own website: Volta Circle is an evergreen family investment firm backed by the Lohia family, founders and majority shareholders of Indorama Ventures Ltd (IVL). It invests seed to Series A in circular-economy technology, focused on Europe, the US and India. Third-party profiles (Preqin, venturecapitalcareers) also describe it as London-based, established around 2018-2019, with team members in London, Geneva, Milan and Bangkok; these were not used as sources for contact fields. The UK legal entity behind the site was not confirmed on Companies House (an exact-name search returned no 'Volta Circle' company). No phone published.
